items.name: activity-feed
items.title: Activity Feed
items.description: A developer telemetry and audit log stream featuring category filtering, live real-time event simulation with Framer Motion slide insertions, and expandable JSON payloads.

items.name: animated-file-upload
items.title: Animated File Upload
items.description: A minimal, physical drag-and-drop file uploader with smooth drop reaction, independent file upload tracking, progressive state morphing, and accessible retry flows.

items.name: animated-number
items.title: Animated Number Morph
items.description: An Apple-grade smooth rolling digit counter that independently morphs individual numerical columns with physics-based springs, locale commas, currencies, and compact notation.

items.name: animated-tabs
items.title: Animated Tabs
items.description: A tabbed switcher with physical pill indicator sliding smoothly between active items with content cross-fades.

items.name: batch-gesture-tray
items.title: Batch Gesture Tray
items.description: A touch-ready contextual tray that slides into view upon item selection, presenting bulk actions and real-time count telemetry.

items.name: book-call-button
items.title: Book Call Button
items.description: A premium "Book a call" pill with a green expanding capsule. At rest, a 36% accent capsule holds a dotted arrow + label; on hover, the capsule fills the pill, the label slides out, and a phone icon with ringing lines fades in centered.

items.name: branching-submenu
items.title: Branching Submenu
items.description: A spatial submenu that connects parent options to child actions with staged branch motion.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: A versatile, production-ready button system with 8 visual variants, 4 sizes, loading spinner states, icon slots, and spring tap feedback.

items.name: circular-orbit
items.title: Circular Orbit
items.description: A circular gallery of image tiles orbiting around a centered title. All motion runs on a single MotionValue driven by useAnimationFrame, so no React renders per frame.

items.name: code-snippet-deck
items.title: Code Snippet Deck
items.description: An interactive multi-runtime developer code snippet deck with runtime switching (cURL, TypeScript, Python, Go, Rust), live dynamic parameter customizations, and line highlighting.

items.name: command-menu
items.title: Command Menu
items.description: A global keyboard-first command palette with fuzzy filtering, category badges, and keyboard arrow controls.

items.name: density-lens
items.title: Density Lens
items.description: An interactive floating lens that tracks pointer movement to reveal high-density data, magnified details, or alternative views.

items.name: dependency-trace
items.title: Dependency Trace
items.description: An interactive SVG node graph that maps and dynamically traces relationship connections with directional bezier curves.

items.name: depth-corridor
items.title: Depth Corridor
items.description: A 3D spatial layer stack with receding perspective depth, progressive focal blurs, and pointer parallax motion.

items.name: directional-tooltip
items.title: DirectionalTooltip
items.description: A tooltip that appears from the direction it originates — it starts a small distance outside the trigger in its preferred direction and springs inward, so it feels like it materializes from the trigger.

items.name: dot-field
items.title: Dot Field
items.description: High-performance lightweight static Canvas dot matrix background with dynamic gradient coloring and responsive density scaling.

items.name: drag-to-confirm
items.title: Drag to Confirm
items.description: A physical drag-to-confirm slider for high-stakes and destructive actions, equipped with elastic spring snapback physics, progressive track illumination, and accessible keyboard fallbacks.

items.name: draw-checkbox
items.title: DrawCheckbox
items.description: A checkbox whose checkmark draws itself (path length animation) and settles with a tiny overshoot. The box scales from 0.9 -> 1.04 -> 1.0 for a tactile snap feel.

items.name: evil-eye
items.title: Evil Eye
items.description: A hanging navy amulet disc with concentric sky-blue and white rings that swings with realistic inertia in response to the pointer, painted as a layered SVG and driven by a single spring pipeline.

items.name: expandable-data-row
items.title: Expandable Data Row
items.description: A polished table component with fluid accordion row unfolding, revealing deep metadata, audit activity feeds, and quick actions, with automatic card restructuring on mobile viewports.

items.name: expandable-search
items.title: Expandable Search
items.description: A compact search pill that smoothly widens on focus with shortcut hint pills and clear button.

items.name: faq
items.title: FAQ
items.description: An expandable accordion FAQ component with smooth spring height calculation, single/multi-open modes, category filtering, search, and full ARIA keyboard accessibility.

items.name: floating-action-dock
items.title: Floating Action Dock
items.description: A floating quick-action toolbar inspired by macOS dock physics with smooth magnification and subtle tooltips.

items.name: focus-mode
items.title: Focus Mode
items.description: An atmospheric focus-mode interaction that isolates selected cards or sections by smoothly dimming surrounding distractions with zero layout shift, tactile spring scaling, and Escape key dismissal.

items.name: form
items.title: Form
items.description: A modular, composable form system with accessible inputs, textareas, custom selects, checkboxes, radio groups, switches, and animated validation messages.

items.name: glass-navbar
items.title: Glass Navbar
items.description: A modern, responsive glassmorphic navbar with smooth spring navigation pills, mobile menu drawer, and keyboard accessibility.

items.name: gooey-menu
items.title: Gooey Menu
items.description: A tactile liquid dropdown menu with organic SVG metaball fusion filter and spring-driven extrusion animation.

items.name: gravity-particle-burst
items.title: Gravity Particle Burst
items.description: A pointer-triggered canvas particle burst with velocity, gravity, friction, and short-lived physical follow-through.

items.name: hamburger-menu
items.title: Hamburger Menu
items.description: An iconic three-line menu toggle that transforms smoothly into a symmetrical close symbol.

items.name: interactive-timeline
items.title: Interactive Timeline
items.description: A developer-focused milestone and deployment timeline featuring dynamic progress lines, pulsating status nodes, expandable telemetry cards, and commit hash copy.

items.name: intro-loader
items.title: Intro Loader
items.description: An Apple-inspired multilingual welcome splash and intro loader that rapidly cycles localized greetings with fluid blur transitions, progress tracking, and accessible skip controls.

items.name: ios-search-bar
items.title: iOS-style Search Bar
items.description: A minimalist search pill that smoothly expands on focus and reveals quick-clear controls with spring animation.

items.name: liquid-ripple-button
items.title: Liquid Ripple Button
items.description: A tactile button whose pointer-origin ripple and subtle wave layer make press feedback feel fluid.

items.name: liquid-toggle
items.title: Liquid Toggle
items.description: A toggle with a liquid/blob-like transition. The internal shape deforms organically as it travels from off to on — stretching along the travel axis and settling into a natural blob shape rather than simply translating.

items.name: loader
items.title: Loader
items.description: A minimal, purpose-driven loading indicator with 4 calm, non-anxious motion variants.

items.name: lock-input
items.title: LockInput
items.description: A text input whose focus state subtly "locks" into place — a focus ring scales in from the center and the border tweens to active, giving the impression that the input snaps closed on itself.

items.name: login
items.title: Login
items.description: A production-ready authentication card built with the EasyUI form system, featuring password show/hide, remember me, validation states, and social logins.

items.name: mac-os-folder-cards
items.title: macOS Folder Cards
items.description: An authentic porcelain-white macOS Finder folder icon that unrolls interactive cards with fluid Apple spring physics.

items.name: magnetic-button
items.title: Magnetic Button
items.description: A responsive button with subtle proximity-based physics that pulls towards the cursor on hover and snaps back on departure.

items.name: metric-hud
items.title: Metric HUD
items.description: An interactive developer telemetry card featuring hardware-accelerated SVG sparklines, pointer-scrubbing point inspection, spring-animated time range morphing, and delta indicators.

items.name: morphing-button
items.title: Morphing Button
items.description: A layout-stable interactive action button that smoothly transitions between Idle, Loading, Success, and Error states without jarring jumps or dimension shifts.

items.name: morphing-dialog
items.title: Morphing Dialog
items.description: An expandable card trigger that fluidly morphs into a centered dialog without jarring popup animations.

items.name: morphing-shape-loader
items.title: Morphing Shape Loader
items.description: A loading indicator that continuously morphs between configurable SVG shapes via real path interpolation. The transition is a genuine geometric morph — never a fade out / in.

items.name: neon-edge-button
items.title: Neon Edge Button
items.description: A button with a restrained light source travelling around the border while the label remains primary.

items.name: nimbu-mirchi
items.title: Nimbu Mirchi
items.description: A hanging lemon-and-green-chilli charm that swings with realistic inertia in response to the pointer, built from layered physical springs rather than a single rigid illustration.

items.name: notification-bell
items.title: Notification Bell
items.description: An interactive notification trigger with animated badge counter, arrival shake feedback, and dropdown panel.

items.name: notification-stack
items.title: Notification Stack
items.description: A stacked notification card system with physical spring stacking elevation, swipe-to-dismiss drag, and simulation triggers.

items.name: orbital-loading-ring
items.title: Orbital Loading Ring
items.description: A lightweight loading indicator with layered rings and orbiting particles that communicate active processing.

items.name: origin-dropdown
items.title: OriginDropdown
items.description: A dropdown with origin-aware expansion — the menu materializes from the chosen side with a slight scale and an inward translation, so its perceived origin is the trigger edge closest to the menu.

items.name: particle-delete
items.title: Particle Delete
items.description: Premium physics-driven particle dissolution delete animation that rasterizes components into thousands of authentic tiny pixels and disperses them smoothly before state removal.

items.name: payment-receipt-printer
items.title: Payment Receipt Printer
items.description: An animated payment and order receipt printer component for React featuring realistic thermal paper extrusion, chassis micro-vibration, customizable receipt itemization, and replay controls.

items.name: payment-status
items.title: Payment Status
items.description: A calm, Apple-grade payment confirmation card with animated SVG path checkmark drawing, staged verification lifecycle transitions, receipt inspection, and failure recovery.

items.name: peek-card
items.title: Peek Card
items.description: An origin-anchored contextual preview popover that emerges directly from target triggers on hover or tap with smart collision edge detection and rich metadata summaries.

items.name: pill-navigation
items.title: Pill Navigation
items.description: A restrained segmented navigation control with shared pill layout morphing and nested submenu dropdown support.

items.name: press-button
items.title: PressButton
items.description: A button that compresses slightly on press and settles with a tiny natural overshoot for a tactile, physical feel.

items.name: pricing
items.title: Pricing
items.description: A minimal two-tier pricing component for EasyUI. Native to the existing design system, fully theme-aware, with a quiet Free tier and a slightly more attractive Pro tier — without resorting to SaaS marketing tropes.

items.name: profile-card
items.title: Profile Card
items.description: A premium dark social profile card with a painted blue cover-art panel, action row, and a detail panel with avatar, verified name, bio, follower stats, and outbound website link.

items.name: recovery-ledger
items.title: Recovery Ledger
items.description: An archival audit timeline and state recovery ledger with chronological snapshot markers, diff inspection, and one-click rollback triggers.

items.name: reveal-card
items.title: Reveal Card
items.description: A high-definition product card with smooth cursor-driven 3D perspective rotation, dynamic glare, and revealed content.

items.name: rocket-party-popper
items.title: Rocket Party Popper
items.description: An interactive black rocket launch that blasts into a colorful party popper confetti shower to reveal celebratory milestones.

items.name: scroll-progress-nav
items.title: Scroll Progress Navigation
items.description: A floating table-of-contents navigation pill that tracks scroll depth, dynamically morphs between resting and floating states, highlights active sections, and enables smooth scrolling.

items.name: selection-basket
items.title: Selection Basket
items.description: A floating bulk-action toolbar that smoothly rises from the bottom of the screen when multiple dataset items are selected, supporting batch operations, horizontal scrolling, and clear triggers.

items.name: settle-modal
items.title: SettleModal
items.description: A modal whose content has a tiny scale/settle instead of a generic fade. The panel scales 0.94 -> 1.02 -> 1.0 with a small y travel, then the inner content layers its own gentle settle on top.

items.name: sign-up
items.title: Sign Up
items.description: A comprehensive registration card with live password strength metrics, password confirmation matching, terms validation, and social onboarding.

items.name: slide-pagination
items.title: SlidePagination
items.description: A pagination control where the active indicator slides between pages rather than instantly switching. The active background uses shared layoutId so the indicator visibly travels from one item to the next.

items.name: small-floating-dock
items.title: Small Floating Dock
items.description: A minimal, gesture-responsive floating dock for quick access to 3-5 primary actions.

items.name: smart-comparison
items.title: Smart Comparison
items.description: An interactive feature matrix and SaaS tier comparison component featuring live difference filtering, collapsible specification categories, search indexing, and mobile card toggle.

items.name: smooth-accordion
items.title: Smooth Accordion
items.description: An accordion component with physics height transition, rotating chevron indicators, and accessible keyboard toggles.

items.name: spotlight-card
items.title: Spotlight Card
items.description: A dark elevated surface that illuminates border and inner surfaces dynamically based on mouse pointer coordinates.

items.name: spotlight-search
items.title: Spotlight Search
items.description: A global command palette and search overlay triggered by ⌘K featuring real-time fuzzy filtering, moving active highlight springs, kbd shortcuts, and full keyboard navigation.

items.name: spring-select
items.title: SpringSelect
items.description: A select dropdown whose menu follows the trigger with a tiny spring. The chevron rotates a hair past 180° before settling, and the panel slides down with a subtle overshoot.

items.name: stack-unfold-panel
items.title: Stack Unfold Panel
items.description: A vertically stacked card deck that unfolds progressively with spring physics, shifting adjacent panels with zero layout jank.

items.name: stretch-switch
items.title: StretchSwitch
items.description: A toggle switch whose thumb stretches slightly while dragging or pressing, then snaps naturally to its destination via a snappy spring.

items.name: text-scramble-decoder
items.title: Text Scramble Decoder
items.description: A controlled text reveal that resolves scrambled glyphs into readable copy without changing the text semantics.

items.name: torque-dial
items.title: Torque Dial
items.description: A rotational control dial with realistic physical angular momentum, velocity tracking, and exponential friction deceleration.

items.name: typewriter-button
items.title: Typewriter Button
items.description: An interactive button that reveals its label character-by-character with optional synthesized mechanical audio feedback.

items.name: undo-toast
items.title: Undo Toast
items.description: An advanced undo notification toast featuring an interactive progress countdown, pause-on-hover mechanics, action reversal animation, and versatile position anchoring.

items.name: unfold-accordion
items.title: UnfoldAccordion
items.description: An accordion whose content unfolds with the chevron and spacing moving together. The chevron rotates 180° while the content height expands and the inner content slides up to close the gap, producing a single, fluid motion.

items.name: velocity-toast
items.title: VelocityToast
items.description: A toast that enters with velocity and settles, with a progress indicator that responds naturally — pauses on hover, resumes with no jump, and eases slightly in the final 10% so dismissal feels intentional.

items.name: wallet-card
items.title: Wallet Card
items.description: A premium dark wallet card with a blue radial-gradient surface, live balance display, iOS-style toggle, and a primary action button. The card surface responds to the pointer with a soft cyan shine driven entirely by MotionValues.
